sqlite.purpose: Immutable, source-bound static validation receipts and administrator-authorized waiver records
sqlite.compatibilityWindow: Additive; readers tolerate no receipt before first full validation.

mysql.purpose: Parity with the SQLite receipt and waiver tables
mysql.compatibilityWindow: Additive; readers tolerate no receipt before first full validation.

rollback: Do not destructively remove receipts. Roll back application reads/writes if needed; the additive table may remain inert until a separately governed retention migration.
dataHandling: No authored Chronicle source is duplicated in the receipt; only checksum, report metadata, safe issues, and digests are stored.
